Tapping lands now offers no benefit—better to preserve sequencing for main phase where I can cast spells. Mana generated in upkeep is identical to mana generated in main phase; anticipate drawing a card this turn and planning Preacher or Enduring Curiosity deployment based on hand quality.
response.plan: Pass to draw step. Draw and assess threats/board state: likely need to rebuild board presence with Preacher of the Schism {2}{B} or Enduring Curiosity {2}{U}{U} in main phase. After drawing, evaluate whether opponent's Siren is still stun-locked (should be if stun counter persists from Drowner). Play Swamp to enable black mana for Preacher or Sheoldred {2}{B}{B} on turn 8. Win condition remains: establish inevitable board presence and reduce opponent to 0 via creatures + card advantage. Current board (3 lands, empty board) suggests rebuilding is critical this turn.

This avoids the risk of playing Swamp and drawing nothing if opponent's response doesn't line up with Curiosity activation.

response.why: Sheoldred offers the best worst-case (45, leaf 11) where even facing their Enduring Curiosity, my 4/5 deathtouch is resilient and drains them on every draw. Cast Preacher and Pass both bottom out at 30 (opponent develops creatures unopposed). Enduring Curiosity worst-case is 35 but leaves me vulnerable to Kaito/multiple creatures. Sheoldred's life drain ($18 vs my 19$) plus draw suppression ('whenever opponent draws, lose 2') makes it the strongest long-term win condition in this midrange mirror.
response.plan: Cast Sheoldred to dominate via inevitability. 4/5 with deathtouch is difficult to remove, and the draw penalty bleeds them out while I gain life—inverting the life totals over time. Even if they respond with threats like Enduring Curiosity, I'm on the axis of card advantage (they draw = I gain, they lose). Tap out with confidence; Sheoldred alone closes the game.

response.why: Cast Enduring Curiosity secures worst-case of 45 (vs Pass worst-case of 30). By deploying the flash creature now, I guarantee it resolves before opponent can remove Sheoldred with Go for the Throat. All Cast Enduring Curiosity leaves leave me with both Sheoldred and Curiosity on board, whereas passing risks losing Sheoldred to instant-speed removal (leaf 2). Even when opponent responds with threats (Kaito, Deep-Cavern Bat), my two creatures are superior and Sheoldred's life drain (they're already at 16 from draw-step drain) compounds my advantage.
response.plan: Cast Enduring Curiosity to lock in two threats on board. Sheoldred suppresses their draws and gains me life; Curiosity will draw cards when creatures deal damage. Even outnumbered on board (their likely 3 vs my 2), the life total gap (16 vs 18, widening via draw) makes Sheoldred's drain inevitable. Holding Preacher for next turn unless they extend past Go for the Throat level of interaction.

response.why: Opponent at 6 life (lethal range). Passing (leaves 0-2, avg 68) lets opponent deploy Enduring Curiosity or Floodpits—opponent develops but still loses next turn. Casting Preacher (leaves 3-5, avg 80) is strongest: guarantees lethal next turn with Preacher (2 dmg + 1/1 token) + Floodpits (2) + Spyglass (1) + token = 6 total, exactly lethal. Leaf 4 shows opponent tapped out after Floodpits response. Sacrificing Map (leaves 6-8, avg 68) converts token to card advantage but doesn't accelerate the win—opponent still gets a turn to respond. Preacher option also handles most opponent responses (even Cut Down in leaf 5 leaves me with two threats and untapped second Preacher).
response.plan: Cast Preacher of the Schism (uses {2}{B} from available {U}{B}{B}{B}). Next turn: Preacher untaps and attacks, creates 1/1 token (2 dmg + token), then swing with Floodpits, Spyglass, token = 6 damage = lethal. Opponent at 6 life cannot block or survive damage resolution. Game ends turn 16 with guaranteed win.

response.why: Preacher successfully cast. Opponent at 6 life with lethal attack guaranteed next turn: two Preachers (4 dmg + 2 tokens) + Floodpits (2) + Spyglass (1) + tokens = 6 damage exactly. Passing (leaves 0-2, avg 69) preserves my {U}{B} mana and forces opponent to respond to four threats on board. Opponent deploying Floodpits (leaf 0) or Deep-Cavern Bat (leaf 1) doesn't stop lethal; Anoint with Affliction (leaf 2) only discards one card. Sacrificing Map (leaves 3-5, avg 57) costs {1} mana to explore and draw a Swamp—accelerates nothing since Swamp doesn't enable lethal or interaction. Leaves me at zero mana, vulnerable to Kaito (leaf 4, score 48, planeswalker is highly threatening when I can't respond). Map token exploration is inefficient when lethal is guaranteed next turn.
response.plan: Pass priority to end postcombat main phase and move toward end of turn. Next turn: untap, Preacher of the Schism attacks (2 dmg + 1/1 token with lifelink), second Preacher attacks (2 dmg + token), Floodpits Drowner attacks (2 dmg), Spyglass Siren attacks (1 dmg) = 6 damage + 2 tokens. Opponent at 6 life dies. Game ends turn 16. Enduring Curiosity draws from each creature's combat damage, but game is already won.
